The '''Resistance transport''' was a model of [[transport]] used by the [[Resistance]] composed by parts taken from different craft during their [[Cold War|conflict]] against the [[First Order]]. One of these vehicles was carrying [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] and her entourage at the end of the [[Battle of Takodana]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:ResistanceTransport2-MF92.png|thumb|left|300px|A Resistance transport with loading doors open.]]
The transport was cobbled together by [[Resistance]] [[technician]]s from parts with different purposes and origins. The ship was controlled from a repurposed [[B-wing Mark II]] [[cockpit]] module that was locked in place and restructured to allow for a docking hatch. The B-wing's life-support systems and portside deflector shield projectors were relocated to within the adjacent cowling, which reduced cockpit visibility and forced the [[pilot]] to use [[Hologram|holographic visual displays]] and a [[sensor]] suite. Engine pods were taken from [[Galactic Republic|Republic]]-era [[Montura-class shuttle|''Montura''-class shuttles]], as they were sturdy and reliable. Faster-than-light travel was allowed thanks to two [[Sienar-Jaemus Fleet Systems]] [[S/min-12a hyperdrive]], a miniaturized model engineered on the [[First Order]] designs. Passengers traveled inside two modular compartments found aboard [[freighter]]s and cut-price [[Starliner/Canon|starliners]]. These compartments were connected and encased with a shell of surplus hull plating. Cockpit was linked to passenger area thanks to a tunnel.<ref name="ICS" />

Although it was usually escorted by [[starfighter]]s, the transport could defend itself. The standard armament consisted in a [[Gyrhil]] [[R-9X heavy laser cannon]], but sometimes other weapons were added: an [[ion cannon]], a [[proton torpedo launcher]], and two [[autoblaster]]s beneath the cockpit. In the standard version a precision [[targeting laser]] helped the pilot. Cockpit and weapons pod were protected by [[deflector shield generator]]s salvaged from B-wings, while their overlapping fields shielded passenger compartments.<ref name="ICS" />

Passengers in the compartments, both [[Resistance trooper|troops]] and commanders, shared space with gear lockers and [[astromech droid]]s.<ref name="ICS" />

==History==
[[File:PammichNerroGoode-SWZ.png|thumb|left|300px|Goode piloted a Resistance transport from the surface of D'Qar]]
The transports were used by the Resistance in its [[Cold War|conflict]] against the First Order. Their use was to deploy troops on ground, after being escorted by fighter to reach the surface.<ref name="ICS" /> One such craft transported [[General]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] and her entourage to [[Takodana]] when the Resistance [[Battle of Takodana|rescued]] [[Han Solo]], [[Chewbacca]], [[Finn]], and the [[droid]] [[BB-8]] from temporary captivity. The transport was piloted by [[Cova Nell]]<ref name="SWZ">{{FFGXW2|set=Resistance Transport Expansion Pack|cardname=Cova Nell}}</ref> and reached the ground only when First Order forces led by [[Ben Solo|Kylo Ren]] had been already put to flight, and General Organa could speak with Han Solo after the end of the battle.<ref name="Episode VII">{{Film|VII}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The transports appear in the [[2015]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']]. The craft went through many design variations, and was one of the final vehicles to be created. The version seen in the film was created by art director [[Kevin Jenkins]], inspired by a [[Wikipedia:Boeing CH-47 Chinook|Chinook]] helicopter turned onto its side.<ref name="The Art">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Force Awakens]]''</ref> At [[Celebration Europe (2016)|Celebration London]] [[2016]], during the DK Panel, the ''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: Incredible Cross-Sections]]'' illustrator [[Kemp Remillard]] revealed that as an [[Easter egg]] he drew himself, author [[Jason Fry]], and other DK staff as the soldiers in the starship's spread.

In the [[2018]] reference book ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles]]'', the transport was mis-titled as an [[SS-54 assault ship]].<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles]]''</ref>
